_comment: Fifteen scenes in the order of the published video. speechText is what the voice says (acronyms spelled for the voice); captionText is the same sentence as written text. The pipeline in video/ reads this file; see docs/video-script.md.

From: orders@helios-home.example.gr
Subject: Order HH-40217 confirmed

Hello Elena,

Thank you for your order at Helios Home Appliances.

Order HH-40217, placed 12 September 2026
1 x De'Longhi Magnifica S ECAM22.110.B coffee machine: 329.00 EUR
Guarantee: 24 months
Delivered to: Athens Apartment 4B

Questions? Reply to this email or write to support@helios-home.example.gr.

segments.captionText: This is Hestia, an everyday agent for the paperwork a household never keeps together. It points at the decisions, and the household makes them.
segments.speechText: This is Hestia, an everyday agent for the paperwork a household never keeps together. It points at the decisions, and the household makes them.

segments.captionText: Meet Elena, in Athens. Her receipts sit in her inbox, her guarantees in a drawer, and her subscriptions renew quietly.
segments.speechText: Meet Elena, in Athens. Her receipts sit in her inbox, her guarantees in a drawer, and her subscriptions renew quietly.

segments.captionText: Then her washing machine breaks, 22 months in, and the repair costs 185 euros. EU rules give at least two years of legal guarantee for faulty goods, but using it needs the receipt, the invoice and the seller's details together.
segments.speechText: Then her washing machine breaks, twenty-two months in, and the repair costs one hundred and eighty-five euros. E U rules give at least two years of legal guarantee for faulty goods, but using it needs the receipt, the invoice and the seller's details together.

segments.captionText: Add a trial about to turn paid, a price that crept up and a missing receipt: small amounts, real deadlines, and nobody keeping watch.
segments.speechText: Add a trial about to turn paid, a price that crept up and a missing receipt: small amounts, real deadlines, and nobody keeping watch.

segments.captionText: Elena adds records by hand or from a pasted email. A Strands agent on Amazon Bedrock points at what needs a decision. Elena approves the exact notice herself; it is recorded, never sent.
segments.speechText: Elena adds records by hand or from a pasted email. A Strands agent on Amazon Bedrock points at what needs a decision. Elena approves the exact notice herself; it is recorded, never sent.

segments.captionText: On AWS, CloudFront serves the app, and API Gateway routes its calls. A read-only Lambda answers reads, and a writer Lambda runs two Strands agents with Claude Haiku on Amazon Bedrock, and saves each private copy to Amazon S3.
segments.speechText: On A W S, CloudFront serves the app, and A P I Gateway routes its calls. A read-only Lambda answers reads, and a writer Lambda runs two Strands agents with Claude Haiku on Amazon Bedrock, and saves each private copy to Amazon S3.

segments.captionText: The review agent only reads, through four tools, and a guard withholds any briefing with entitlement wording or a euro amount no tool returned. The reading agent has no tools: it proposes records from pasted text, and nothing is added until Elena confirms.
segments.speechText: The review agent only reads, through four tools, and a guard withholds any briefing with entitlement wording or a euro amount no tool returned. The reading agent has no tools: it proposes records from pasted text, and nothing is added until Elena confirms.

segments.captionText: This is the live app. One click opens a private copy of Elena's household, with no account, for 30 minutes.
segments.speechText: This is the live app. One click opens a private copy of Elena's household, with no account, for thirty minutes.

segments.captionText: Home starts with three ways to add records. Below them are five decisions waiting, from the washing machine repair and a trial ending in three days, to a price rise and a missing receipt.
segments.speechText: Home starts with three ways to add records. Below them are five decisions waiting, from the washing machine repair and a trial ending in three days, to a price rise and a missing receipt.

segments.captionText: Elena pastes the order email for a new coffee machine. The reading agent proposes the product, the seller, the date and the price. She checks them, and confirms before anything is added.
segments.speechText: Elena pastes the order email for a new coffee machine. The reading agent proposes the product, the seller, the date and the price. She checks them, and confirms before anything is added.

segments.captionText: Then she asks Hestia to review the household. The Strands agent calls its four tools, and Claude Haiku on Bedrock writes a short briefing that points at the decisions. The chips show the live model, the tokens and the reviews left, and the tool trace shows every call and what it returned.
segments.speechText: Then she asks Hestia to review the household. The Strands agent calls its four tools, and Claude Haiku on Bedrock writes a short briefing that points at the decisions. The chips show the live model, the tokens and the reviews left, and the tool trace shows every call and what it returned.

segments.captionText: The repair matters most. Hestia prepares the exact notice from the recorded facts: the seller, the subject and the repair cost. Elena reads it and approves it with a single-use token bound to that exact text. The approval is recorded, and no email is sent.

segments.captionText: The case file keeps the story in one place: the approved notice and the next step, then every reply, deadline and outcome she records.
segments.speechText: The case file keeps the story in one place: the approved notice and the next step, then every reply, deadline and outcome she records.

segments.captionText: And the About page shows what runs, and what is not connected yet, such as bank feeds and email sending.

segments.captionText: Hestia turns scattered household paperwork into decisions a person can act on. Two Strands agents read and point, the household decides, and every step stays in one case file. It is open source, and the live demo needs no login. The links are in the description.
